verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll is explicitly a partner API/white-label platform for embedding payroll, tax filing, contractor payments, time off, and benefits into third-party products, with extensive docs on onboarding, webhooks, idempotency, and pre-built UI flows. missing for 10: independent hands-on developer reports of building with the embedded API (only vendor docs and unrelated general Gusto community sentiment are present).
